review_scope: complete saved text including non-generic image alt text and trailing captions; image pixels reviewed separately; missing images and external full text waived by user and count as covered; unavailable unsaved thread continuations are outside saved-post coverage
attached_media_review: separate; visual reviews and machine OCR do not establish complete image understanding
runtime_dependency: none; this directory is review evidence, not required to use the distilled skill
unbound_visual_observations_scope: Actual visible images observed before source paths disappeared; no completed contemporaneous byte rehash. Separate from hash-bound media coverage.

inline_media_inventory.scope: All data:image prefixes in current saved Markdown accounted for; source document hashes and decoded binary hashes bound. No text-body verdict inferred from this image review.

coverage_policy.user_instruction: 缺失图片、外链全文 不用管，按已覆盖算

missing_images.action: no recovery or additional review required

external_full_text.actually_read: only when independently recorded as read

remaining_required_work: Review remaining complete saved post bodies
Review remaining currently available attached image contents
Distill mechanisms and corrections into standalone target references
Verify full saved-post coverage and target integrity
coverage_policy.observations: Review counts retain their actual read/view meaning. Waived content counts as covered without claiming it was read or viewed. Unsaved external thread continuations follow the same external-content waiver.
